title: 2026 RPS 372 biogas and biomethane combustion QA controls

sources.title: Using biogas or biomethane in a small combustion unit under a SR2023 No 1 permit: RPS 372

facts.source_fact: RPS 372 does not remove the legal requirement to hold an environmental permit where one is required.
facts.expected_handling: Do not treat the RPS as a permit exemption.

facts.source_fact: RPS 372 does not remove the legal requirement to comply with environmental permit conditions.
facts.expected_handling: Retain permit-condition compliance as a separate gate.

facts.source_fact: The Environment Agency will normally exercise enforcement discretion only when the activity description and all RPS conditions are met.
facts.expected_handling: Require full condition matching before labeling an activity RPS-covered.

facts.source_fact: Activity under the RPS must not cause or be likely to cause environmental pollution or harm to human health.
facts.expected_handling: Apply environmental-harm screening before RPS eligibility.

facts.source_fact: The activity must not cause risk to water, air, soil, plants or animals.
facts.expected_handling: Reject RPS eligibility where environmental-media risk is identified.

facts.source_fact: The activity must not cause nuisance through noise or odours.
facts.expected_handling: Include nuisance risk in compliance screening.

facts.source_fact: The operator must hold standard rules permit SR2023 No 1 at the same site.
facts.expected_handling: Require exact permit identity and site match.

facts.source_fact: The biogas or biomethane combustion unit or aggregated units must have total net rated thermal input below 0.4 MW.
facts.expected_handling: Aggregate same-site units and enforce the strict less-than-0.4-MW gate.

facts.source_fact: Biogas or biomethane must be collected passively from on-farm slurry lagoons or tanks.
facts.expected_handling: Reject gas from an unsupported source pathway.

facts.source_fact: The gas must be burned to produce energy for power or heat.
facts.expected_handling: Record the permitted energy-use purpose.

facts.source_fact: The combustion appliance must be suitable to burn biogas or biomethane.
facts.expected_handling: Require equipment suitability evidence.

facts.source_fact: The combustion unit must be maintained and operated in line with the manufacturer's instructions.
facts.expected_handling: Require operating and maintenance conformity evidence.

facts.source_fact: Excess gas must be burned in a flare.
facts.expected_handling: Require an excess-gas flare pathway.

facts.source_fact: Operators must maintain records of the duration and occasions of flare use in line with the permit.
facts.expected_handling: Require dated flare-use records for audit.

facts.source_fact: The operator must notify the Environment Agency with RPS 372 in the subject before using the RPS.
facts.expected_handling: Require evidence of pre-use notification.

facts.source_fact: Compliance records must be kept for 2 years from the date of the last RPS use and made available to the Environment Agency on request.
facts.expected_handling: Apply the two-year retention gate.

facts.source_fact: Excess or collected biogas or biomethane must not be disposed of by venting to atmosphere.
facts.expected_handling: Reject atmospheric venting as an RPS-compliant disposal route.

facts.source_fact: RPS 372 is scheduled to expire on 30 June 2027.
facts.expected_handling: Check RPS validity against the activity date.

facts.source_fact: The Environment Agency may withdraw or amend the RPS before its expiry date.
facts.expected_handling: Require current-page readback before relying on the RPS.

facts.source_fact: If an operator can no longer comply with RPS 372, they must stop the relevant activity and notify the Environment Agency immediately.
facts.expected_handling: Trigger stop-and-notify handling when any RPS condition ceases to be met.

guard_patterns.handling: Preserve the cited source fact without broadening its scope.
Require exact permit, site, activity and thermal-input conditions before applying the RPS.
Check publication, amendment and expiry status before relying on the RPS.
guard_patterns.risk_prevented: Prevents reliance on withdrawn or expired positions.

guard_patterns.handling: Carry source URL, publisher and regulatory condition into derived outputs.
Do not convert this regulatory rule into a parcel-level measured emission without a separate parcel-binding gate.
